current_activity: part of the battalion landing at Aola Bay
notes: Miller, ch. VII: on 29 November 1942 four transports landed the 3rd Battalion of the 147th Infantry, additional elements of the 246th Field Artillery Battalion, part of the 9th Defense Battalion, and more Seabees at Aola Bay. The claim locates the battalion by the part Miller names. The rest of the battalion later joined the force at Koli Point after 3 December, but that remainder has no calendar day in the pages read, so no second landing is entered. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
